Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:11:1.hebrew: ליחזי דידיה כמה הוו כו' - ויראה כמה חסרו, ויטול על של חברו כפי חשבון:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:11:1.english: Let him see how much his [produce] was, etc. - And he will see how much they diminished, and he will deduct for his fellow's [produce] according to the calculation.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:14:1.english: The measure of the threshing floor - was larger than that of houses.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:15:2.english: With a measure [bekhayla] - With a measure.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:15:3.english: During the season of the threshing floor - Close to their drying, when they dried in the sun.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:15:4.english: And he returned [it] to him during the rainy season - [The produce] swelled again from the moisture of the rain and the cold.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:16:1.english: If so - that its nature is to swell.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:16:2.hebrew: לפקע כדא - כשממלאין כד חיטין או שעורין בימות הגורן וגפין את הכד, יפקע בימות הגשמים מחמת תפיחת התבואה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:16:2.english: The jug should burst - When they fill a jug [with] wheat or barley during the threshing season and seal the jug, it should burst during the rainy season due to the swelling of the grain.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:16:3.hebrew: איצצא - דוחק. מתוך שהם במקום צר, נדחקו יחד ואין תפוחין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:16:3.english: Compression - Pressure. Because they are in a narrow place, they were pressed together and are not puffed up.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:17:1.hebrew: ליין - אם הפקיד אצלו יין ועירבו עם יינו, הקנקנים בולעין שתות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:17:1.english: For wine - If [one] deposited wine with him and he mixed it with his [own] wine, the casks absorb one-sixth.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:17:2.hebrew: אף המוכר כו' - כשם שאמרו במפקיד, כן אמרו במוכר: שהמוכר שמן לחבירו ונותן לו מתוך חביותיו כשהוא מסתפק תמיד, והוא מזוקק, הרי הלוקח מקבל עליו לפחות לו לוג ומחצה מחמת שמרים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:17:2.english: Even one who sells, etc. - Just as they said regarding one who deposits [oil], so they said regarding one who sells [it]: that one who sells oil to his fellow and gives [it] to him from his casks when [the buyer] draws supplies continuously, and it is refined, the buyer accepts upon himself [for the seller] to deduct for him a log and a half on account of sediment.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:17:3.english: For one hundred - For one hundred log.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:18:1.hebrew: חפו בקירא - טחו החביות מבפנים בשעוה, כדרך שעושין אנו בזפת:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:18:1.english: They coat with wax - They coated the casks on the inside with wax, just as we do with pitch.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:18:3.hebrew: גרגישתא - קרקע שעושין ממנה החביות, ארדלי"א בלע"ז:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:18:3.english: Gargishta - Earth from which they make the casks, ardille [clay] in Old French.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:18:4.hebrew: הא - באתריה דר"י מייץ טפי מההיא דאתריה דתנא קמא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:18:4.english: This [earth] - In the locale of Rabbi Yehuda, [it] absorbs more than that of the locale of the first Tanna.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:19:1.hebrew: באתריה דרב יהודה - מילתא באפי נפשיה היא, ולאו אמתניתין קאי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:19:1.english: In Rav Yehuda's place - [This] is an independent matter, and it does not refer to our Mishnah.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:19:2.hebrew: רמו ארבעין ותמניא כוזי בדנא - מדה קטנה היתה במקומו, שארבעים ושמונה ממלאין את החבית:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:19:2.english: They poured forty-eight pitchers into a barrel - It was a small measure in his place, [such] that forty-eight [of them] fill the barrel.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:19:3.english: The barrel went for six [zuz] - It was sold all together for six zuz during the grape-harvest season.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:19:4.english: Rav Yehuda divided it, six [pitchers] for a zuz - Rav Yehuda became a shopkeeper and would sell them [at] six pitchers for a zuz.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:1:1.hebrew: וכן אמר רבה השביחו לאמצע - לא גרסינן, שאין זה לשון גמרא להביא דברי האמוראים סיוע למשנה; ועוד, רבה תלמידיה דרב חסדא הוה, והיכי אמר רב חסדא שמעתא משמיה? ואי גרס ליה, "וכן אמר רב" גרסינן, שהיה רבו של רב חסדא. משום דאיכא למ"ד בבבא בתרא (דף קמג:): "לא שנו אלא ששבחו נכסים מחמת נכסים, אבל שבחו מחמת עצמן של אחים — השביחו לעצמן", אמרה רב חסדא להא דרב הכא, למימר דלית לן ההיא שמעתא, אלא אפילו השביחו מחמת טורחן של משביחין — כי הכא, דשתל פרדס — השביחו לאמצע:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:1:1.english: And likewise Rabbah said: They enhanced [the property] for the common [estate] - We do not read [this text], for it is not the style of the Gemara to cite the words of the Amoraim as support for a Mishnah; and furthermore, Rabbah was a disciple of Rav Chisda, so how could Rav Chisda state a teaching in his name? And if one does read it, we read "And likewise Rav said," for [Rav] was Rav Chisda's teacher. Because there is one who says in Bava Batra (143b): "[The Sages] taught [this] only where the property appreciated on its own, but where [the property] appreciated through [the efforts of] the brothers themselves, they enhanced [it] for themselves," Rav Chisda stated this [teaching] of Rav here, to say that we do not hold by that teaching, but rather even where they enhanced [it] through the exertion of those making the improvements — such as here, where he planted an orchard — they enhanced [it] for the common [estate].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:1:2.english: They knew - These [older brothers knew] that [the younger brothers] would take their share.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:1:3.english: Did he know - That he had brothers.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:2:1.hebrew: גדולה מזו - קרוב היורד לנכסי שבוי, שאם יבאו הבעלים יטלו שלהם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:2:1.english: Greater than this - [This refers to] a relative who enters the property of a captive, for if the owners come, they will take what is theirs.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:2:2.hebrew: אמרו שמין להם כאריס הכא דידיה לא יהבינן ליה - בתמיה, זה שעשה והשביחן לדעת עצמו, לא יהבי' ליה כאריס בחלק השני:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:2:2.english: They said: We appraise for them as a sharecropper; here, [for] his own, do we not give him? - [This is said] as a rhetorical question: this one, who worked and improved them on his own initiative, do we not give him [payment] as a sharecropper for the second portion?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:3:1.hebrew: ברשות ב"ד נחתי - דמורידין קרוב לנכסי שבוי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:3:1.english: With the authorization of the court they descended - For [the court] authorizes a relative to descend [to] the property of a captive.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:3:2.hebrew: הכא לא ברשות נחית - כשירד זה לתוכו, לא נמלך בב"ד:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:3:2.english: Here, he did not descend with authorization - When this one descended into [the property], he did not consult with the court.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:3:3.hebrew: ועוד - אם בא לימלך, לא היו מורידין אותו, דהא אחיו קטן הוה, ואין מורידין קרוב לנכסי קטן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:3:3.english: And furthermore - If he had come to consult [the court], they would not have authorized him to descend [to the property], for his brother was a minor, and they do not authorize a relative to descend to the property of a minor.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:5:1.hebrew: הרי זה יוציא לו חסרונות - כשיחזירם לו, יפחות כמה הם רגילים לחסור. ובגמ' מוקי לה בשעירבן עם פירותיו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:5:1.english: That [bailee] deducts for him [the] decreases - When he returns them to him, he deducts how much they normally decrease. And in the Gemara, it establishes it [as referring to a case] where he mixed them with his [own] produce.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:5:3.english: Millet - Petil [Old French for millet], and [it is] similar to rice.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:5:4.english: All [is] according to the measure - And so for each and every kor.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:5:5.hebrew: הכל לפי הזמן - שהניחן בידו, לכל שנה ושנה יניח לו כך:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:5:5.english: All according to the time - [The time] that he left them in his possession; for each and every year, he deducts for him this [amount].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:6:1.hebrew: ר' יוחנן בן נורי אמר - אהכל לפי המדה פליג:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:6:1.english: Rabbi Yochanan ben Nuri said - He disagrees with [the ruling], "all according to the measure."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:6:2.hebrew: אם היתה מדה מרובה - שהפקיד אצלו הרבה, ובגמרא מפרש: י' כורים — לא יוציא לו חסרונות מפני שהם מותירות; שבימות הגורן, כשמפקיד, החיטין יבשין, ובימות הגשמים, כשמחזיר, נופחות. ובאכילת עכברים אינן נחסרים כל כך לכל כור וכור, דכולי האי לא אכלי עכברים מי' כורין. הלכך, נפיחתו משלמת חסרון המגיע לשני כורים או שלשה שהעכברים אוכלין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:6:2.english: If [the deposit] was a large measure - that he deposited a large amount with him — and in the Gemara it explains: ten kor — he does not deduct decreases for him because they increase [in volume]; for in the threshing-floor season, when he deposits [them], the wheat is dry, and in the rainy season, when he returns [them], they swell. And through the eating of mice, they are not diminished so much for each and every kor, for mice do not eat that much from ten kor. Therefore, its swelling compensates for the decrease amounting to two or three [kor] that the mice eat.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:7:1.hebrew: זרע פשתן בגבעולין - חסר כל כך, לפי שהגבעולין מתייבשין ונופלים והרוח מנשבתן, אבל זרע פשתן נקי אינו חסר כ"כ:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:7:1.english: Flaxseed on [its] stalks - [It] decreases so much because the stalks dry out and fall off, and the wind blows them away; however, clean flaxseed does not decrease so much.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 40a:8:1.english: For each and every kor - [This] is an explanation of the Mishnah.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40a:13:1.hebrew: מדה מרובה י' כורין - וא"ת: אפי' ב' כורין או ג' מתנפחין לפי חשבון החסרונות העולה להם! וי"ל: דבי' כורין עולה להם הנפוח חסרון של כור אחד, ולא יוציא להם חסרונות — היינו כל החסרון, דחסרון של כור אחד לא יוציא; ולהכי נקט י' כורים לאפוקי פחות:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40a:13:1.english: A large measure [is] ten kor - And if you ask: Even two kor or three [kor] swell according to the proportion of the decreases that accrue to them! And one can answer: With ten kor, the swelling amounts for them to a decrease of one kor, and "he does not deduct decreases for them" — that means the entire decrease, for he does not deduct a decrease of one kor; and for this reason [the Gemara] stated ten kor, to exclude less [than ten].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40a:1:1.hebrew: וכן אמר רבה גרס - רש"י גרס: "וכן אמר רב", ופליג אמ"ד בפ' מי שמת (ב"ב דף קמג: ושם ד"ה לא): נכסים ששבחו מחמת עצמן של אחין — השבח לעצמן, וקאמר דאפי' שבחו מחמת טרחם של משביחין, כי הכא דשתל פרדיסא — השביחו לאמצע. וזהו תימה שחולק רבא על רב, דהתם רבא קאמר, ולא מייתי התם מילתיה דרב. ונראה דגרס: "רבה", וכן בספר ר"ת. ולא מדברי רב חסדא הוא, שהגמ' מביא שמעשה כיוצא בזה בא לפני רבה, ופסק דהשביחו לאמצע כמו רב חסדא. והביאו הגמרא משום קושית אביי, דא"ל אביי לרבה: "מי דמי" כו', ולא חשש רבה מקושיותיו ודן דהשביחו לאמצע:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40a:1:1.english: He reads: "And likewise, Rabbah said" - Rashi reads: "And likewise, Rav said," and [Rav thus] disagrees with the one who said in the chapter [entitled] Mi Shemet (Bava Batra 143b, and there, s.v. lo): "Properties that appreciated on account of the brothers themselves — the appreciation belongs to themselves," whereas [Rav] says that even if they appreciated through the exertion of those who improved [them] — like here, where he planted an orchard — they improved [it] for the common [estate]. And this is astonishing, that Rava disagrees with Rav, for there it is Rava who states [that view], and [the Gemara] does not cite Rav's statement there. Rather, it appears that [one should] read "Rabbah," and so it is in the book of Rabbenu Tam. And it is not part of Rav Chisda's statement, for the Gemara brings [this] that a similar incident came before Rabbah, and he ruled that they improved [it] for the common [estate], like Rav Chisda. And the Gemara cited it because of Abaye's objection, for Abaye said to Rabbah: "Are [they] comparable?" etc., and Rabbah did not pay heed to his objections and ruled that they improved [it] for the common [estate].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40a:2:1.english: The matter continued - [i.e.,] the ruling of Rav Ḥisda, and it came before Rabbi Ami:

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40a:6:1.hebrew: וכי מה אכפת להו לעכברים - וטעמייהו דרבנן מפרש בירושלמי: "הני עכברי רשיעי נינהו, כד חמיין עיבור לא מסתייהו דאכלי, אלא קריין לחבריהון דאכלי עמהון". והא דאמרינן בגמרא "אמרו לו: הרבה אובדות מהם, הרבה מתפזרות מהם" — י"ל דלדבריו דרבי יוחנן קאמר: אפילו לית לך טעמא דמפרש בירושלמי, מ"מ הרבה אובדות מהם:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40a:6:1.english: "And what do the mice care" - And the Rabbis' reason is explained in the Jerusalem Talmud: "These mice are wicked; when they see grain, it is not enough for them that they eat, rather they call their fellows to eat with them." And [as for] that which we say in the Gemara, "They said to him: Much is lost from them, much is scattered from them" — one can say that it is speaking according to Rabbi Yoḥanan's own view: even if you do not accept the reason that is explained in the Jerusalem Talmud, nevertheless much is lost from them.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40a:6:2.hebrew: אלא לכור בלבד - וא"ת: אם כן, בפחות מכור נמי יוציא כמו לכור? וי"ל דאין להם ריוח להטמן בתוכה, ומ"מ לפי חשבון הראוי להתחסר יוציא, דאי אפשר שלא יתחסרו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40a:6:2.english: Except for a kor alone - And if you ask: If so, for less than a kor as well, he should deduct [the same amount] as for a kor! And one can answer that [in a smaller pile] they do not have room to hide inside it; nevertheless, he deducts according to the proportion [of produce] that is expected to decrease, for it is impossible that there would be no decrease.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40a:7:1.hebrew: ולאורז שאינו קלוף ג' סאין לכור - וא"ת: ואמאי לא חשיב במתניתין אורז שאינו קלוף עם זרע פשתן, כיון דאית להו חד שיעורא? וי"ל: דפשוט לו דבאורז תתחסר כל כך. וברישא, גבי אורז קלוף, לא חשיב זרע פשתן קלוף, דשמא דינם חלוק:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 40a:7:1.english: "And for unshelled rice, three se'ah per kor" - And if you ask: Why does [the Tanna] not list unshelled rice together with flaxseed in our Mishnah, since they have one [and the same] measure? And one can say: Because it was obvious to him that rice would decrease that much. And in the first clause, regarding shelled rice, he does not list shelled flaxseed, because perhaps their laws are different.
